verdict.rationale: Orama has a public pricing page, and it states that the open-source library is free to use at no cost, so self-hosted search spend is predictable. The pack shows no per-unit rates (per search, per record, or per node) for the managed Orama Cloud service, so a founder cannot model managed costs from this evidence. Missing for 10: published per-search, per-record, or per-node pricing for Orama Cloud; tier limits or overage rates; independent confirmation of pricing transparency.
